news.label: Spy×Family Season 4 + Film
points: Season 4 and a theatrical film for 2027
details: The Spy×Family anime staff announced a fourth season and a new film in Japanese theaters in 2027.
They also revealed a visual for the fourth season.
Season 3 premiered in October 2025 and ran for 13 episodes, according to Anime News Network.

lines.say: First up, Spy Family. The staff confirmed a fourth season, and a new film in Japanese theaters in twenty twenty-seven.
lines.show: First: Spy×Family — Season 4 and a 2027 theatrical film.

lines.say: They also revealed a Season four visual. Season three aired last October with thirteen episodes.
lines.show: Season 4 visual is out — Season 3 had 13 episodes.

link.title: Spy×Family Anime Gets 4th Season, Theatrical Film in 2027
link.description: The staff announced a fourth season and a new film in Japanese theaters in 2027, and revealed a visual for season 4.

news.label: Laid-Back Camp Season 4
points: Themes by Asaka and Eri Sasaki
Shin Tosaka directs at FuRyu Pictures
details: The official Laid-Back Camp Season 4 site posted the main trailer and visual, announcing an April 2027 premiere.
The trailer previews Asaka's opening Brand New. and Eri Sasaki's ending Happa no Tegami.
Shin Tosaka returns to direct at FuRyu Pictures, with returning cast including Yumiri Hanamori and Nao Toyama.

lines.say: Next, Laid-Back Camp. The main trailer confirms Season four will premiere in April twenty twenty-seven.
Asaka sings the opening, Eri Sasaki the ending, and Shin Tosaka directs again at FuRyu Pictures.
lines.show: Theme songs previewed — directed by Shin Tosaka at FuRyu Pictures.

link.title: Laid-Back Camp Season 4's Trailer Unveils April 2027 Debut
link.description: The main trailer and visual announce an April 2027 premiere and preview the theme songs.

news.label: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2
points: Listed in Nintendo UK's November lineup
details: Nintendo UK lists The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026.
The post describes a remake with reimagined visuals, a refreshed soundtrack, and modernised gameplay.
The same November slate also includes Metaphor: ReFantazio and Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition on November 12.

lines.say: On the games side, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake arrives on Switch two on November fifth.
lines.show: Games: Zelda Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2 — Nov 5.

lines.say: Nintendo U K says it brings reimagined visuals, a refreshed soundtrack, and modernised gameplay.
lines.show: Updated visuals, music, and gameplay — via Nintendo UK.
